newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: De Beers shares at year high after results.
newsitem.headline: De Beers shares at year high after results.

text.p: Shares in diamond group De Beers moved to a year high in early Tuesday afternoon trade after the group reported earnings jumped 37 percent in the year to December 31.
Shortly before 1200 GMT, the company announced earnings per linked unit rose to 354 U.S. cents compared with 259 U.S. cents the year before.
At the time the results were announced, De Beers' shares were trading up 75 cents at 158.25.
At 1210 the counter was trading up 200 cents at 159.50 rand after briefly touching a year-high of 159.75.
Some 125,213 shares worth 19.84 million rand had changed hands in 77 deals.
